name: M86-Erezlife
description: Extracts enrolled MAIN-campus students and accepted housing-desiring applicants for the next upcoming Fall or Spring term and pushes residence_applicants.csv to eRezLife SFTP (sftp.us.erezlife.com:/studentlists/). Target term resolves dynamically.

parameters.name: sftpKey
parameters.label: eRezLife SFTP Private Key
parameters.description: OpenSSH RSA 2048 private key for sftp.us.erezlife.com authentication. Public counterpart is registered with eRezLife (sent to Kyra Gibson). Must include the header and footer verbiage.

parameters.name: sftpUsername
parameters.label: eRezLife SFTP Username
parameters.description: Production username assigned by eRezLife (TBD until they confirm). Use the *-testimport account for test runs.

parameters.name: includeHeaders
parameters.description: eRezLife spec requires column titles matching field abbreviations. Must be true.

parameters.name: quoteStrings
parameters.description: Quote strings on CSV to handle commas in names and addresses safely.

config.selectQuery:
WITH
  target_term AS (
    SELECT
      terms_id
    FROM
      dbo.ods_terms
    WHERE
      term_start_date > CURRENT_DATE
      AND (
        terms_id LIKE '%FA'
        OR terms_id LIKE '%SP'
      )
    ORDER BY
      term_start_date ASC
    LIMIT
      1
  )
SELECT
  s.students_id AS student_id,
  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  pe.person_email_addresses AS email,
  s.students_id AS external_auth_id,
  CASE p.gender
    WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
    WHEN 'F' THEN 'F'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS gender,
  SUBSTRING(
    (
      SELECT
        terms_id
      FROM
        target_term
    )
    FROM
      5 FOR 2
  ) || SUBSTRING(
    (
      SELECT
        terms_id
      FROM
        target_term
    )
    FROM
      1 FOR 4
  ) AS admit_term,
  TO_CHAR(p.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birthdate
FROM
  dbo.ods_students s
  JOIN dbo.ods_person p ON p.id = s.students_id
  LEFT JOIN people_email pe ON pe.id = p.id and pe.pos = 1
WHERE
  s.stu_current_home_location = 'MAIN'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      dbo.ods_student_programs sp
    WHERE
      sp.stpr_student = s.students_id
      AND sp.stpr_current_status = 'A'
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  a.applicants_id AS student_id,
  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  pe.person_email_addresses AS email,
  a.applicants_id AS external_auth_id,
  CASE p.gender
    WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
    WHEN 'F' THEN 'F'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS gender,
  SUBSTRING(
    ap.appl_start_term
    FROM
      5 FOR 2
  ) || SUBSTRING(
    ap.appl_start_term
    FROM
      1 FOR 4
  ) AS admit_term,
  TO_CHAR(p.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birthdate
FROM
  dbo.applicants a
  JOIN dbo.ods_applications ap ON ap.appl_applicant = a.applicants_id
  JOIN dbo.ods_person p ON p.id = a.applicants_id
  LEFT JOIN people_email pe ON pe.id = p.id and pos = 1
WHERE
  ap.appl_start_term = (
    SELECT
      terms_id
    FROM
      target_term
  )
  AND a.app_housing_desired_flag = 'Y'
  AND ap.current_status_control = 'AC'
